target_customer: Product and growth teams and developers who build sign-up, login and onboarding flows
problem: Large companies assign whole engineering teams to signup flows while most cannot. Arengu offered a low-code builder for forms and flows connected to any API, claiming 20 to 30 percent conversion lifts.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription low-code form and flow builder
product_category: Developer tools, sign-up and onboarding flows

founders.name: Pablo Castro Valino
founders.background_notes: Frontend developer and internet freedom activist, involved with GPUL.

technical_complexity.rationale: A visual flow builder with API connectors, embeddable forms and passwordless logins, standard engineering with some hard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Customers embed flows into production signup, but identity vendors and form tools could add the same features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Okta, owner of Auth0, acquired Arengu in 2023 to extend its customer identity flows.

market_need_then: Signup conversion and passwordless login were priorities for product teams, and Auth0 customers needed customizable flows beyond hosted login pages.

identity.voice_and_tone: plain developer and growth focused copy; founder bios are playful

branding.community_and_virality: Had a WordPress plugin, Arengu Forms, and a Gatsby plugin; WordPress plugin closed 2024-03

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive invented name but no evidence of brand-level press or community; searches for name origin returned nothing.

outcome_analysis: Arengu was a Galician team of three that started in 2018, raised about 500,000 euros led by K Fund in 2020 and joined YC in Summer 2021. It reached a customer base that made it attractive to Okta, which acquired it in June 2023 (dated by CB Insights and a June 2023 report, while the K Fund post is dated February 2024). The small raise and strategic acquisition indicate a capital efficient outcome.
notes: Website arengu.com returned 404 when fetched. Pre-seed was EUR 500,000, amount_usd left null to avoid computing a conversion.
